scope: Synthetic CPU and pinned-Pi-SDK structure/lifecycle checks; no semantic quality or superiority certification

requirements.property: Only active selected branch entries populate memory; exclusions and thinking purges remain effective
Excerpts fit an explicit estimator budget, preserve source identities and chronology, and label omission and unverified claims
Recent-tail selection never splits a tool group; orphan, duplicate and missing results fail closed; oversized units are explicit
Deterministic memory construction uses no extra inference, preserving the canonical provider history
Original messages remain immutable and continuity metadata survives real SDK reopen and repeated compaction
Bounded read-only Git status targets only the requested workspace, suppresses fsmonitor/filter side effects and excludes untracked file contents
Recovery binds source identity and continuity content rather than reusing stale summary evidence
Alt+C uses exactly the existing checkpoint text and never a replacement request; Escape retains cancellation semantics
Source controls are JSON-escaped; excerpts preserve Unicode and cannot become raw chat-template delimiters
All rendered plan, source, task, Git and file envelopes fit one headroom-adjusted character budget; loaded instructions are not duplicated
Only eligible selected tool or plan paths are captured; exact bounded UTF-8 files and digests take precedence over stale write arguments, while large and unsafe paths become explicit references
Selected-branch plan state persists independently of summary generation; explicit context exclusions suppress linked material
Only structured recorded handles and unresolved calls are restored; historical handles and missing results are never asserted to be live processes
Writer and reader share a byte ceiling, valid multibyte summaries recover intact, and oversized receipts never publish

The completed notice and new saved compaction count use selected historical tokenization after exclusions rather than stale assistant usage; old authenticated receipts and Radiance history displays use their recorded exact count without rewriting source bytes or extra inference
Fresh same-model Qwen usage triggers at the earlier of 240000 and context window minus configured reserve; disabled, malformed, absent and stale usage do not interrupt

Received reasoning and prose are persisted exactly once before checkpoint generation and survive JSONL reopen; an oversized interrupted message is summarized in active context rather than silently kept past the tail budget; unexecuted partial tool calls never execute or gain fabricated results

Original work continues without a synthetic user prompt only after a durably saved checkpoint; cancellation, disk-save failure, checkpoint failure and superseding context prevent automatic continuation
